main.description: As `knotless dismiss` does: the repository's owner or a collaborator writes a dev.knotless.comment on the pull naming the review in `dismisses`, its body the reason. The review then counts for nothing, for or against the pull, until its reviewer reviews again. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

description: Dismisses a reviewer's standing review of a pull, as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
